rationales: A matrix is an arrangement of data, not a graphical representation of an algorithm.
A graph represents relationships or data, not the steps of an algorithm.
A flowchart graphically represents the steps of an algorithm.
A solution is an answer to a problem, not a graphical representation of an algorithm.
Checking may be part of solving, but a problem should first be analyzed.
Testing is generally done after a solution or program has been developed.
Analyzing a problem is the first step before planning its solution.
Output is the result produced after processing, not the first step.
The symbol ∨ represents the logical OR operator.
The symbol ¬ represents logical NOT.
The plus sign is not the standard symbol for the logical OR operator here.
The symbol ∧ represents the logical AND operator.
“It is cold outside” is a proposition that can be evaluated as true or false.
A categorical proposition asserts a relationship between categories, which this sentence does not.
A moral proposition concerns judgments of right and wrong, unlike this sentence.
“Good proposition” is not the appropriate logical classification for this statement.
Text may be communicated over a network, but it is not the general function named here.
Numbers may be transmitted, but they are not the general function named here.

Area is not what a network facilitates among connected devices.
A password of eight characters can contribute to good password security.
Avoiding the username makes a password less predictable.
Including uppercase letters can help make a password stronger.
Using only your name makes a password easy to guess and is not a good password practice.

The `background` attribute was used in the body tag to specify a webpage background image.
The attribute `bgimage` is not the standard body attribute for this purpose.
The attribute `backimage` is not the standard body attribute for this purpose.
An IPv4 address does not contain 29 bits.
An IPv4 address does not contain 30 bits.
An IPv4 address does not contain 31 bits.

The terminal symbol marks the start or end of a flowchart.
A connector links different parts of a flowchart.
A process symbol represents an operation or instruction.
A decision symbol represents a branching choice.
A random error is not the standard term for an algorithm that runs but produces incorrect results.
A logical error lets a program run but causes it to produce incorrect results.
A syntax error violates the rules of the programming language and usually prevents execution.
A runtime error occurs while a program is running, often interrupting execution.
Base 16 is used by the hexadecimal number system.
Base 10 is used by the decimal number system.
Base 8 is used by the octal number system.
The binary number system has base 2.
HTML provides more than four heading levels.
HTML provides more than five heading levels.

HTML has six standard heading levels, not eight.
The associative law changes grouping, not the order of propositions.
The distributive law relates the distribution of one operation over another.
The commutative law states that changing the order of propositions does not change the result.
The identity law describes the effect of combining a proposition with an identity element.
A patent can protect an invention or other qualifying intellectual property.
Copyright law protects original creative expression rather than an idea by itself.
A trade secret protects confidential information kept secret by its owner.
Piracy is unauthorized copying or use, not a way to protect an idea.
Routing is not specifically defined as sending data through a channel.
Routing forwards data toward a destination, commonly across different networks.
A path is a route taken by data, but the sentence describes routing between networks.
Area is not the standard term for the separate locations connected through routing.
